Field notes · October

Autumn at the footbridge

What we found at the footbridge, and what to do before winter.

The river

The river , and both times the footbridge held. The second rise came within a hand of the deck boards, which is closer than any year since the bridge was rebuilt.

MLMaya Lindqvist3m ago

Was it twice? The log says once, on the 14th.

We recommend raising the deck by one course before the spring melt. The cost is modest and the work can be done in two days with the water low.

MLMaya Lindqvist5m ago

Two days is optimistic. Last time the same job took a week; say so, or give a range.

The path

MLMaya Lindqvistjust now

A map of the north bank here would help.

The path on the north bank is washed out for about twenty metres. Walkers are cutting across the meadow, which is doing more harm than the river did.

Reopen the page with its comments

Open in prototypereview.html#reopen-page

Show the page as Maya left it: her threads beside their paragraphs, her name on them, comment mode off.

Persona at this step
MLMaya Lindqvist

A week on, Maya opens the same file again. She expects her comments to be there without signing in to anything.

Content
  • The report with her three threads at rest beside their paragraphs, the words thread's highlight and the pin, the tag reading 3.
  • Comment mode off: she is reading. Her name on every card, kept from last time.

MLMaya Lindqvist

Content
  • The page with no cards, no highlight and no pin: Hide comments is on.
  • The tag still reads 3, and its menu's Hide comments row reads On.
Wording
  • Hide comments · On the menu row while comments are hidden.
Components
Comment control corner
States
  • EmptyNot applicable
  • LoadingNot applicable
  • ErrorNot applicable
Interactions
  • Hide comments fades every card, highlight and pin out over --ds-motion-settle; turning it off fades them back. The choice is remembered for this page in this browser.
  • Comment mode, All comments and a comment being written still show the comments while they last, and they hide again when they end.
Requirements
  • FR-025 Hide comments puts every card, highlight and pin out of sight until it is turned off, while the control still counts the open threads, and the choice is kept for the page in that browser.
Acceptance criteria
  1. AC-hide-comments-1FR-025PassedGiven three threads showing, when Maya turns on Hide comments, then no card, highlight or pin shows and the tag still reads 3.

Find a thread whose words were cut

Open in prototypereview.html#content-gone

Keep a thread whose paragraph was removed from the page reachable and counted, flagged rather than lost.

Persona at this step
MLMaya Lindqvist

The author cut the paragraph Maya commented on. Her comment is still hers; she wants to find it.

Content
  • The page, now without the paragraph "We recommend raising the deck…": the river section has one paragraph.
  • All comments open: the list holds the three threads; the one on the cut paragraph is marked "Content gone · was in The river" above its card, and opening it says where it was with no line to the page.
  • The tag reads 3: a thread with no place is still counted.
Wording
  • Content gone · was in {section} above a thread whose content left the page.
Components
Comment card openComments panelPopover menu iconAvatar smButton primary, quietChip filterHighlightIcon button quietKeyPinSwitchText field
States
  • EmptyNot applicable
  • LoadingNot applicable
  • ErrorThis step is the recovery for a changed page: nothing else can fail.
Interactions
  • A thread follows its content when the page changes; one that cannot is flagged in All comments instead of landing in the wrong place, and still copies as Markdown with where it was.
  • Opening it in the panel shows its words and replies; there is nothing on the page to scroll to.
Requirements
  • FR-026 A thread whose content is gone from the page stays listed and counted in All comments, marked as content gone with where it was, and is never dropped or attached to the wrong place.
Acceptance criteria
  1. AC-content-gone-1FR-026PassedGiven a thread on a paragraph that was cut, when Maya opens All comments, then the thread is listed with "Content gone · was in The river" and the tag counts it.
  2. AC-content-gone-2FR-026PassedGiven that thread, when she copies as Markdown, then the text holds it with where it was.
Prompt for this screen

This journey

Come back to a page later

Maya reopens a page days later: her comments and her name are still there, she hides them to read in peace, and a thread whose words were cut is still listed, marked as content gone.

Goal
Maya picks up where she left off: her comments, her name and her choices are kept, and nothing she said is lost when the page changes.
Trigger
A week later the author sends a new version of the page, or Maya just wants to read it again.
Outcome
She sees her threads where they were, hides them to read, and finds the one whose paragraph was cut, flagged rather than lost.
Success
Comments, the name and the hidden choice survive a reopen in the same browser (FR-023). A thread whose content is gone is listed and counted, never silently dropped.
